create_tsm_resnet_v2: create a TSMResNetV2 model with configurable depth, num_frames, and channel_shift_fraction for video understanding
build_tsm_resnet_block: build a TSMResNetBlock with temporal channel shifting, stride, projection, and bottleneck configuration
build_tsm_resnet_unit: build a TSMResNetUnit block group containing multiple TSMResNetBlocks with shared channel and stride settings
test_tsm_resnet_v2: test TSMResNetV2 forward pass with inputs of shape [B, T, H, W, C] or [B*T, H, W, C] and specified final_endpoint
review_tsm_resnet_v2_deflation: review TSMResNetV2 deflation mode with alpha_deflation parameter and output_stride configuration for feature grid stride control
